name: Volkov-Saito Precision VSR-20 'Partisan'
description:
Volkov-Saito Precision built the VSR-20 for asymmetric warfare. The Partisan is a select-fire rifle chambered in 6.8mm caseless with a heavy barrel profile optimized for sustained accurate fire from fixed positions. Where other assault rifles prioritize mobility and rate of fire, the VSR-20 prioritizes first-round accuracy and sustained fire without thermal degradation.

The rifle features a liquid-cooled barrel jacket that circulates a thermal management fluid, allowing the VSR-20 to maintain accuracy through extended engagements that would warp a conventional barrel. A built-in bipod deploys from the forend, and the stock adjusts for length, cheek height, and cant angle to accommodate any shooter regardless of body type or prosthetic configuration.

Volkov-Saito markets the Partisan to defensive security forces and territorial militias, but its true customer base is any group expecting to fight a sustained engagement against a superior force. The VSR-20 does not win firefights through volume — it wins through persistent, accurate, demoralizing fire that pins advancing forces and bleeds them at range.
specifications:
caliber: 6.8mm caseless
effective_range: 600m
rate_of_fire: 600 rpm (cyclic)
magazine_capacity: 25 rounds
weight: 4.5 kg
tactical_use: The VSR-20 excels in defensive engagements where sustained accuracy matters more than mobility. Its liquid-cooled barrel maintains sub-MOA accuracy through hundreds of rounds that would render conventional barrels inaccurate. Paired with a competent marksman and good cover, a single Partisan can suppress an advancing squad. The heavy caliber and accurate fire create a psychological deterrent beyond its physical lethality.
cultural_context: The Partisan has become synonymous with community defense against corporate expansion. Its name invokes historical resistance movements, and Volkov-Saito has leaned into this identity. In Tier 1-2 communities facing corporate encroachment, the VSR-20 represents the ability to impose costs on aggression. Corporate security briefings list the Partisan as a primary threat indicator for organized local resistance.
story_hooks: A Volkov-Saito engineer is secretly providing Partisan maintenance manuals and upgrade kits to resistance groups — the company officially denies involvement while quietly supporting their best customers.
A settlement's defense depends on three Partisan operators holding a chokepoint. If any of them fall, the position is lost and the community is overrun.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately heavy, architecturally angular assault rifle with a pronounced forward-weighted profile. The liquid-cooled barrel jacket gives it a distinctive ribbed, almost skeletal appearance along the muzzle end. The stock is modular and angular, suggesting industrial precision rather than ergonomic softness. Overall impression: a weapon built for grinding attrition rather than speed.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length 1020mm (adjustable stock: 950–1050mm), barrel length 530mm, width across cooling jacket 85mm at widest point
physical_description.weight_description: Noticeably hefty but balanced—the liquid-cooled barrel system distributes weight forward predictably. Feels planted and stable in a supported position; unbalanced for rapid movement but reassuring in a foxhole
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer lower receiver (dark gray-black) with integrated aluminum-alloy cooling jacket surrounding steel barrel. Upper receiver is tool steel with mil-spec hard-coat anodizing
physical_description.finish: Matte black polymer with brushed anodized aluminum on cooling jacket. Heat-stress discoloration common on well-used examples—bronze and amber patina on jacket where thermal cycling has oxidized the aluminum
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal black primary with natural brushed aluminum secondary (cooling jacket). Accent details in muted gunmetal gray
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive cross-hatch polymer on pistol grip and forend. Rubberized cheek rest on adjustable stock. Cooling jacket surface is smooth anodized aluminum—intentionally cold to the touch
distinctive_features: Prominent ribbed liquid-cooled barrel jacket with visible inlet/outlet ports near muzzle and mid-barrel
Integrated bipod that deploys from forend (thin steel arms, rubber feet)
Three-position adjustable cheek riser on stock (mechanical detents, visible height steps)
Cant-adjustable stock with indexed rotation collar
Upper receiver has integrated Picatinny rail with light-duty optical mount pre-fitted
Magazine well shows wear rings from repeated insertions; magazine is flush-fit 25-round polymer type
Thermal indicator strip on cooling jacket (color-shift polymer that darkens with heat)
Charging handle is oversized and ambidextrous
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VOLKOV-SAITO PRECISION in small sans-serif stamp on upper receiver just forward of charging handle. Cyrillic/Japanese fusion logo (overlapped V and S characters) on left side of magazine well. Serial plate (stainless steel) mounted on lower receiver, stamped with production date and batch code. Model designation 'VSR-20' and 'PARTISAN' engraved (not inlaid) on stock in English
physical_description.condition_typical: Field examples show wear consistent with active use: polymer grip has micro-scratches from tactical gloves, cooling jacket bears thermal stress marks and minor dents from hard contact, bipod feet show rubber wear. Kept scrupulously clean otherwise—dust and debris impair cooling efficiency. Well-maintained weapons show pristine internals; neglected examples exhibit rust blooming on exposed steel surfaces
